The game

A lot of clever moves.

Guide Nibbly through colorful puzzles, collect every sweet, and leave enough room for that ever growing tail.

Make it your adventure

200 puzzles.
So many sweet moments.

Start with 20 free levels and unlimited retries. The optional Full Adventure opens the rest of the campaign, plus a Level Workshop for making puzzles of your own.

  • ✳ Play with touch controls, your way
  • ✳ Progress stays on your device
